title: Rectangles
description:
Define a struct `Rectangle` with two `double` members, `width` and `height` (in that order). Then write:

- `double area(const Rectangle& r)`,
- `void scale(Rectangle& r, double factor)`: multiplies both sides by `factor`, changing the caller's rectangle.

Note which function takes `const&` (it only reads) and which takes `&` (it changes).
